extracted.intended_audience: Catholic faithful / communicants seeking devotional guidance (readers of a Manual of Piety)
extracted.subtask_description: Practical and spiritual guidance for how to prepare oneself, participate in Mass, and receive the Eucharist with the right dispositions (humility, faith, devotion, and liturgical participation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Approach Communion with ardent desire and fervent love
rubrics_metrics.description: Receive the sacrament with burning desire, tears, hunger and 'sainte avidité' — a heart opened to be refreshed by the sacred Body.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The text contrasts communicants who receive with 'tant de froideur et de sécheresse' with those whose hearts 's'ouvrent également pour s'y désaltérer.' It presents ardent desire as a sign of Christ's presence and as the proper affective posture for Communion (examples: tears, 'transports d'une joie ineffable').

rubrics_metrics.name: Ardent faith as proof of Christ's presence in the sacrament
rubrics_metrics.description: A heart 'tout brûlant' that recognizes the Lord in the fraction of the bread is offered as evidence of the sacramental presence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quotation used as authority: 'ils reconnaissent véritablement le Seigneur dans la fraction du pain, ceux dont le coeur est tout brûlant...' — fervent affective faith is presented as the sensible sign that the sacrament truly communicates Christ.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acquire devotion through humility and self-abnegation
rubrics_metrics.description: Desire fervor, ask repeatedly, wait patiently, receive grace with gratitude and preserve it with humility; grow in detachment from created goods and die to self.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical steps: 'ne vous lasser jamais de la demander... la recevoir avec gratitude, la conserver avec humilité'; the stronger the renunciation of worldly things ('plus un homme renonce ... plus la grâce vient à lui promptement'), the more ready one is to receive fervor.

rubrics_metrics.name: When fervor is lacking, practice humble patience and self-examination
rubrics_metrics.description: If you feel little or no fervor, humble yourself but do not be excessively distressed; attribute lack of grace to your own sins and remove the small obstacles that impede grace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance: 'lorsqu'elle vous est cependant ou refusée ou ôtée secrètement, ne l'imputez qu'à vous-même et à vos péchés.' Note that 'c'est souvent peu de chose qui arrête' — attention to small faults can restore grace.

rubrics_metrics.name: Present personal needs to Jesus in Communion with simplicity and confidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Expose your infirmities, needs, sins, and temptations to Christ during Communion; ask him to heal, strengthen, and refresh you.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mode of prayer: speak to Jesus 'comme un ami parle à son ami.' 'Nous avons des besoins, il faut les lui exposer. Nous sommes couverts de plaies, il faut les lui montrer, afin qu'il les lave dans son divin sang.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer yourself and all virtues; desire mystical union and transformation
rubrics_metrics.description: Approach Communion offering yourself wholly (sacrifice of self and possessions), seek to be clothed in virtues and the 'robe nuptiale' so as to share mystical union and be transformed by Christ.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concrete devotional intention: imitate Mary and saints' reception, ask to be 'transformé en vous' and to 'être revêtu de nouveau ... de cette robe de l'innocence et de la sainteté.' The Eucharist is presented as the source of inner transformation and remission of sins.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not attempt to probe the mystery of the Eucharist; submit senses to faith
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid a curious, speculative desire to penetrate the sacramental mystery; prefer faith and simple obedience over intellectual scrutiny of what is 'impénétrable.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Warnings and rationale: 'Celui qui scrute la majesté sera accablé par la gloire.' 'Ce qu'on demande de vous, c'est la foi et une vie pure, et non une intelligence qui pénètre la profondeur des mystères.' Reason must follow faith, not precede it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respond to doubts and temptations by trusting Scripture, Fathers, and humility
rubrics_metrics.description: When tempted to doubt the sacrament, attribute such attacks to the enemy rather than to yourself; do not argue with intrusive thoughts but rely on God's word and the Church's witnesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical counsel: 'Ne vous troublez point, ne disputez point avec vos pensées... croyez à la parole de Dieu, croyez à ses Saints et à ses Prophètes.' Trials of faith are often proof of being a target for spiritual attack.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attend Mass with modesty, attention, respect, and proper dispositions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Mass should be attended with modesty, attention, respect, and Christian dispositions: unite with the priest, adopt the spirit of Christ, and offer yourself with him and through him.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preparatory actions: 'Assistez donc à la sainte messe avec modestie, avec attention, avec respect; venez-y avec des dispositions vraiment chrétiennes; prenez-y l'esprit de Jésus-Christ, offrez-vous avec lui et par lui.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Be properly disposed before approaching the altar (contrition and detachment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not approach the Eucharistic banquet without the 'robe nuptiale' — remove attachment to sin, confess and renounce sins, seek purification and reconciliation before Communion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Imagery and instruction: 'Purifiez mon âme; les choses saintes sont pour les saints... ôte auparavant mes souliers de mes pieds, c'est-à-dire l'attachement ... au péché.' The Confiteor and interior contrition are emphasized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participate actively in the liturgy: unite in prayers, responses, and gestures
rubrics_metrics.description: Join the priest in the orations and offerings, respond 'Amen' and the set acclamations, understand liturgical texts (Kyrie, Gloria, Credo, Preface), and make the prescribed gestures (standing for the Gospel, signing the cross).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explanatory notes: the Kyrie is repeated to 'exciter l'attention et la ferveur'; the Gloria is 'cantique de joie'; rising for the Gospel 'afin de marquer que nous devons tout quitter pour suivre Jésus-Christ'; sign on brow/mouth/heart indicates readiness to profess and live the Gospel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expect spiritual fruits even without sensible consolations; value darkness and purification
rubrics_metrics.description: Not all valuable graces are felt as consolations; walking in the darkness of faith, suffering, and interior abnegation can be more meritorious and safer than seeking solely felt fervor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reflection: 'Les grâces les plus précieuses ne sont pas toujours les grâces senties... Souvent il est plus sûr de marcher ... dans les ténèbres de la pure foi.' The manual praises humility and interior mortification as superior to conspicuous fervor when necessary.
